audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Shen Levels 2, 3, First item; the whys under those rows say Ambessa is ahead before Shen has E, 'she wins straight trades here' at 3, and that Eclipse is her spike. Packet levelChart is Skill, Skill, Ambessa, Skill, Ambessa, Ambessa, Shen.
audit.why: Her dash comes off the passive from level 1 and her Q-into-transformed-Q chain is online at 3, while Shen's answer is a 18s rank-1 Shadow Dash. She keeps the edge through Public Execution and her first item; two tank items flip it back.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-2 Skill; Level 3 Ambessa; Levels 4-5 Skill; Level 6 and First item Ambessa; 2+ items Shen. Proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Spikes cover Lvl 3, Lvl 6, first item and 2+ items and line up with the corrected chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry names none of Ambessa's abilities and invents 'Repeating Dashes' as her signature. It also calls her dash a W ability and her ultimate a snare. Real kit: Drakehound's Step (P) is the dash and empowered-attack reset, Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W) is a braced shield that grounds, Lacerate (E), Public Execution (R) blinks to the farthest champion in a line, SUPPRESSES on arrival, then slams for a stun and heals her.
audit.why: A fabricated ability name is unusable at the loading screen — the player cannot track a cooldown that does not exist. Repudiation grounds, which is what actually denies Shadow Dash and Stand United's arrival dash, and Public Execution is a suppress, so tenacity does not shorten the lock.
audit.corrected: Every occurrence of 'Repeating Dashes' replaced with Drakehound's Step; her W renamed Repudiation and the dash attributed to the passive; R restated as suppress-then-stun. dontsFull[0].d now carries the Grievous Wounds cue for Public Execution's healing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The punishable cooldown was named as a fictional ability.
audit.why: Repudiation at 18/17/16/15/14s is the shield-and-ground she needs for a favourable trade; Public Execution is 130/115/100s.
